data_rules.bosses: Populate only from authoritative or clearly attributed research; do not invent boss names.
data_rules.loot: Record confirmed loot only and keep source references per item or boss relationship.
data_rules.blueprints: Track dungeon-boss Blueprint drops separately from ordinary loot when confirmed.
data_rules.recipes: Link confirmed Blueprint rewards to recipes and professions using stable entity IDs.
data_rules.mechanics: Do not infer encounter mechanics from similarly named Classic content.
